content.text: Before starting, think briefly about the plan. Then call the web_fetch tool 13 separate times, one call per URL, in this order, waiting for each result before the next call (do not use bash): https://example.com/?n=1 , https://example.com/?n=2 , https://example.com/?n=3 , https://example.com/?n=4 , https://example.com/?n=5 , https://example.com/?n=6 , https://example.com/?n=7 , https://example.com/?n=8 , https://example.com/?n=9 , https://example.com/?n=10 , https://example.com/?n=11 , https://example.com/?n=12 , https://example.com/?n=13. Never combine commands into one call. After the last one, reply DONE.
